resources.string: This app contains no game data. It plays your own dump of the Korean cartridge (ADMK), which it copies into its own storage the first time. Other regions, revisions and patched ROMs are not supported.
The file could not be copied. Try again.
Leave the game?\nProgress not saved in the game is lost.
Autosave: the town is saved aside whenever the game would let you save (every minute, and when you leave the app), and the next start asks whether to go on from it
There is an autosave (%1$s).\nIt is newer than the last save made in the game. Where do you want to go on from?
Mr. Resetti comes after quitting without saving
One tall picture: the 3D scene continued onto the upper screen (takes effect at the next start)
3D resolution (experimental; takes effect at the next start; each step is much heavier)

Vulkan renderer (experimental, takes effect at the next start): the 3D scene at the screen\'s own resolution, antialiased. Used in place of the 3D resolution above; turns itself off where the device cannot do it
Carry the wireless to other ports (takes effect at the next start)
Server address (empty: a room is opened on this device)

With this on and the app started again, the DS\'s local wireless (opening the gate, visiting) reaches the other devices of the same room, four at most. On one Wi-Fi network, one device leaves the address empty and opens the room, and the others enter its address (shown below under how it is running). With people elsewhere, everybody enters the address of a relay (acww-relay).
Carry Wi-Fi Connection over this device\'s network (takes effect at the next start)
Name server (for a private server, e.g. 192.0.2.10)

With this on and the app started again, the game finds an access point called \"acww-kor-port\", and what it sends over Wi-Fi goes out through this device\'s network. Nintendo\'s own servers are closed: enter the name server (DNS) a private server tells you to use, one that takes unpatched games by DNS alone. The title\'s \"something else\", \"Wi-Fi settings\" has a connection test. The console\'s address and Wi-Fi user are made on this device and kept with it. Playing together, when on, comes first.
The app\'s copy of the ROM will be removed and the app will close. The save is kept.
That file is not a save (a save is 256 KB).
